author: CrashCourse
description:
Earthquakes can happen anywhere on Earth, at any time—and unfortunately, we have no way of predicting exactly when or where. But by studying and tracking seismic data, scientists continue to refine forecasts, better assess the risks, and even research how to prevent and protect us from the most damaging shocks.
